snapshot.scope: E6.10 Home grounded-answer citation validation and honest insufficiency projection.

reviewers.independence: Planning reviews the prompt, context, quality and trace contracts; Development supplies the separate deterministic validator and Home integration evidence.

dimensions.summary: The final projection is local and bounded: exact Host refs project, unknown or required missing refs become localized insufficiency, and ordinary prose remains pass-through.
Prompt, Context, Quality, Playbook, traceability, acceptance and decision owners share one post-final validation boundary without adding a repair turn.
E6.10 and PIGE-EVAL-004 remain partial while recording executable exact-ref, unknown-ref, required-missing-ref and ordinary-answer evidence.
A 60-line deterministic owner closes the evidence-authority gap without another Provider call, new renderer contract or semantic routing layer.
Existing Prompt, Context, Quality, Playbook and trace owners hold the decision; no new design document or duplicate status surface is introduced.

verification.evidence: Exact Host refs, unknown refs, grounded missing refs, source turns that skip inspect and ordinary general answers are covered at the validator and Home integration boundaries.

verification.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:architecture-reset
verification.evidence: The candidate compiles and builds while Home remains within its frozen architecture budget and the new 60-line validation owner is inventory-bound.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: Prompt, Context, Quality, Playbook, decision, acceptance projection and semantic-claim lock remain mutually consistent.

coordination.compatibility: No public schema, prompt round-trip or durable format changes; ordinary general answers remain pass-through and evidence-bound failures use the existing insufficient_evidence projection.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning records exact Home citation validation evidence while E6.10 and PIGE-EVAL-004 remain partial for broader quality, breadth, scale and platform proof.
